descriptions.text: Cheat Code Potion Warning: This item has a short shelf life. This item will expire shortly after it was generated. In other words, this isn't something you can hoard. Don't be a wuss. Drink it now. Causes one, recently-used combat or magic-themed skill to increase by three. Choice is random and permanent.

recap.text: Carl drinks the Cheat Code Potion from the silver boss box the moment he sees its red timer, already down to seventeen minutes, and adds it to his hotlist first. It crackles in his mouth like a whole packet of Pop Rocks and raises his Pugilism by three, to level ten. With Iron Punch, Powerful Strike and his unarmed bonus, his fists now hit as hard as Brandon's lightning maul.

Among the classes on offer, Prizefighter adds three to Pugilism. The Cheat Code potion has already taken that skill to ten, so Carl thinks the bonus would be huge. He would pick the class in a second if he thought he could just punch his way through the dungeon, but he already knows he can't.

Katia asks Mordecai why Pawna's Tears is so valuable when they have seen skill potions, potions that max a skill out, and Cheat Code potions that give three levels. Mordecai answers that it is plus five to any skill he chooses. Legendary potions that max a skill exist for only a few skills. The Cheat Code potion is precious too, plus three to a random skill, but its shelf life is short, so it must be taken immediately.
